intent: Expand The Black House with the complete observed set of public sonoxo forks whose GitHub direct parent is a deptofdefense repository and the complete public U.S. Naval Research Laboratory repository catalog, preserving provenance and officiality boundaries.

plan.collection: Read public GitHub organization, repository, parent, source, and default-branch metadata for the DoD-source fork graph and NRL catalog.
plan.normalization: Separate official organization-hosted repositories, third-party upstream roots, and independent sonoxo forks.
plan.integration: Register pinned Black House ecosystem manifests and bind the LLMs-at-DoD and NRL public-repository ontologies.
plan.verification: Run deterministic fail-closed validators and regression tests.

evidence.finding: GitHub marks the organization verified for dds.mil and archived.
63 public organization repositories; 38 verified direct sonoxo forks in the pinned snapshot.
Pinned fork heads, direct parents, transitive roots, coverage gaps, and guardrails.
LLMs-at-DoD tutorials and workflows mapped to exact source artifacts and notebook cells.
58 public NRL repositories; identity corroborated by official nrl.navy.mil pages linking NRL GitHub software.
58 repositories, 57 pinned heads, one empty repository, one upstream fork, metadata indexes, and fail-closed controls.
Typed materialization rules for repository, head, upstream, language, license, topic, and review objects.

metadata.officialityRule: deptofdefense namespace is verified organization-hosted source; sonoxo namespace is an independent fork
